summary: John P. Novak, 31, of Minturn died kayaking on the Eagle River near the Eagle County Fairgrounds on a private, non-commercial river trip with two friends; wearing a PFD and helmet; Vail Mountain Rescue + Eagle County SO + Greater Eagle/Gypsum fire and Western Eagle County ambulance responded for recovery
location: Eagle River near Eagle County Fairgrounds
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue; Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: 2011-06-25 = Saturday (article: died Saturday afternoon, identified Sunday by Eagle County coroner); cause pending autopsy at time of report. Fills thin 2011 Eagle year; inserted run 706.
